title: Mixed Event — Smile of a Dreamer

meta.Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime picks up the pace in preparation for their final Show Contest performance! At the same time, Emu learns that her brothers are working on a huge overhaul of Phoenix Wonderland. She tries to convince them to reconsider, but will she be successful?

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's call it a day!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay♪ Today's practice felt really extra awesome♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I kind of want to keep doing more... Hey! Why don't we get a head start on what we're doing tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And how about for tomorrow, we can do stuff for the next day and the next day and...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene

rows.Speaker: Emu

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But the next show is the last one for the Show Contest. It would be nice to put as much effort as we can into it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, you might be right. I'd be okay with our audience simply enjoying the show, but...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We've made it this far, so I guess we should try to outdo the Phoenix Stage troupe and win it all.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Precisely! This contest is our chance to make Wonderlands×Showtime known throughout the world!

rows.Line: That brings me to my next point. I'd like to have a discussion about the program tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A discussion?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed. I've already talked this over with Rui, but I think the program this time around should include as many ideas as possible.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd like to include KAITO and the others in this discussion as well.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, that sounds like fun! We can chit and chat until our faces turn blue♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Do you actually understand what's going on...?

rows.Line: Ms. Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm? Mr. Mascot, what's up? It's not time to go yet, is it...?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: I received word that your brothers will be returning home sooner than expected and I thought that I should inform you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Th-They are...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, hold up. What's going on?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, uh... It looks like my big brothers are coming home a little early!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Big brothers? You have older siblings, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I have two big brothers and a big sister!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So that means... There's four of you...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh, I'm surprised. I thought you were an only child like Rui or me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, what are they like?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Umm... My oldest brother is all rules, rules, rules, and my other brother is like a prickly pear!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But my big sister's super soft and cuddly♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay... I sort of understand but not really...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Each is unique in their own way then.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And does them coming home early this time mean that they're usually late?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup. My big sister's a university student, so she's usually home...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But my big brothers help run this park, so they're always out late going to dinner meetings and parties and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They run this... Wait, Emu. Does that mean your big brother's the president of Phoenix Wonderland...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: He is...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: My oldest brother's the president and my other brother is the managing director.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: My dad's the one that makes sure all of the companies are doing okay.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-This feels like it's right out of a movie or TV show...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. But it's also not surprising that members of the Otori family would be in these kinds of positions as well.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... The more I hear about them, the more powerful they seem...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In any case, if they're not usually around all that much, why not go home and see them, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We can clean up in your place, so it's okay for you to go on ahead.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! You're the best, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whoa! Easy! You don't have to tackle me as thanks every time, you know?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe♪

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Oh... Umm...
Keisuke, Shosuke. You're back...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We just arrived a moment ago.

rows.Line: When was the last time we all sat down and had dinner together? Tonight, you can relax a little.

rows.Line: We shall.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: It's a shame that Mother couldn't be here today, but her volunteer work in Cambodia will keep her there well into next week so...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: But we can ask her all about it when she gets back.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Oh, Father...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: About our plans for next quarter. We are still planning on installing new rides and attractions moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Uh...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: And the other plan I mentioned earlier will also soon...

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: That I'll leave to you...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes. Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're putting in more new rides and stuff...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We are. Our current situation limits how many visitors the park can gather and accommodate.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: The Show Contest helped briefly boost those numbers, but it's hard to believe that it'll ever end up being a long-term solution.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh...? The Show Contest...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You were the ones that came up with that idea?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Indeed. We needed a way to attract more visitors.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: The park has ten stages of various sizes in total, but not all of them are contributing to the figures we've been seeing.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Naturally, each troupe is compensated for their efforts. However, in order to see if they're actually pulling their weight and attracting visitors, we came up with the Show Contest.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But grandpa said that shows aren't about winning or losing...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: You still believe that?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: We're the ones operating the park now. We won't stay afloat if we keep sticking to that geezer's ideas.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But... Aren't there other ways to attract more visitors?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I mean, I have some ideas too... Like having some days where adults can go on the kiddy rides maybe?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That way, the people that came when they were kids can come back and relive their experiences from back then! Or how about doing shows in front of the station and...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: We don't have the time or money to spend on weak ideas like that!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Father may've let you keep your precious stage, but don't let that get to your head...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But...!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Emu, I'm sorry. We do not plan on making any changes at this point.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Emu...
Emu's Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So it's all gonna completely change...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, wait...! I can't let myself think like that...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I have to believe that if I try extra hard, I can save grandpa's park...!

rows.Line: (I just have to do a bunch of shows and get a bunch of people to come and watch so that my brothers won't have to put in new rides or attractions! They'll understand!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Today's gonna be wonderhoy!
Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm? No one's here? Maybe they're in the living room...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: It's finally the day of the inspection...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: At last, things are starting to move along. It took so long just to get to this point...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: We can finally go back to being a respectable theme park.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: And we'll need to decide soon which attraction to scrap next.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: The Trampoline Dome seems like a viable candidate. It's a low-yield attraction that's only meant for children so...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I remember you really loved the Trampoline Dome, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! The feeling of jumping around all those fluffy clouds was the best!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed. It's been one of your favorites since you were little. We'd always go to the Trampoline Dome, but you kept begging us to go back in for seconds or even thirds.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: W-Waaaait...!!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: E-Emu...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're just gonna tear this down too?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know that you want to build new rides and stuff to attract more visitors, but...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: There are tons of people that love the Trampoline Dome! And they'll all be super sad if you do tear it down!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Sad...? There's no way anyone in their right mind would feel an attachment to that thing.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: There is! One of my friends really loves it...!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Oh, fine. A small handful of people aside, even they'll end up forgetting about it as time passes.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: And if our negotiations tomorrow go as planned, you'll start seeing new rides and attractions pop up left and right. Everyone will be drawn much more to those too, obviously.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh? Negotiations?
What are you talking about?!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: It's none of your business.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But...!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I shall explain...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Tomorrow, we'll be meeting with Riley Entertainment to finalize a licensing agreement that will allow us to use their characters.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: As I'm sure you're already aware, Riley Entertainment produces and distributes films, some of which have become blockbusters that spawned a variety of popular characters.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland will have themes centering around these characters from now on.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Why...?! We already have Phenny and Poochie and...!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
You mean those primitive relics?
I'm amazed they've lasted this long.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Plus, it's a simple fact that Riley Entertainment's characters have the respect and adoration of young fans all over.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: If we can tap into that demographic, this park will advertise itself through social media and let us earn revenue more efficiently since it would save us the trouble of having to do so ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: If we need to advertise, then I can help do that through our shows!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We've tried everything we can up to this point to increase our visitors...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: That is why we arrived upon overhauling this park's theme. Any rides or attractions that don't fit with this theme will be removed as a result.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: B-But...!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We're out of choices.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: But don't worry. The Wonder Stage will remain a key piece as long as it can attract visitors...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No... You're just not getting it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The park is supposed to be about making people laugh and smile...!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Sigh... You're still spouting what that geezer used to say? His old adages just don't help us get visitors!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, I get that they sound old...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I know that we don't have as many rides and stuff as the bigger parks, or that what we have won't get as many visitors as we could...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But everyone that came before has fond memories of the Trampoline Dome and Haunted House. They still remember it all...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So I want us to think about the visitors more too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I think that we have to do that to be a truly great park!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Your head is in the clouds...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: And we can't survive on just nice ideals.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But...!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: What's going on? I heard someone yelling and...

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: You're causing a disturbance...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sis... Dad...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Keisuke and Shosuke were talking about partnering with another company to tear down a bunch of rides and stuff...!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: Ah, is that what this is about...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know that we need new rides to help bring in more visitors...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I'm really worried that everyone that came before will be really sad or disappointed if it really does happen!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Grandpa always said that he wanted to make it a place where everyone can laugh and smile...

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: This is what it means to run a business.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Do you finally understand? We won't make it just by pandering to your whims and needs.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (What do I do...? If this really happens, everyone's memories will all disappear...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I want to do something about it... B-But...!)

rows.Line: What do you mean rethink this partnership?! We're about to finalize everything, you know...?!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Do you not understand how much money is changing hands over this deal?!

rows.Line: Everyone at the Wonder Stage even came up with an idea to make it more fun and attractive!

rows.Line: That way, more people will come and play, and they'll be laughing and smiling. Grandpa's PXL can stay the way it is and we'll get more visitors!

rows.Line: Exactly. Business is about results. I suggest that you free yourself from these ideals of yours...

rows.Line: Our little stage that was on the brink of collapsing now gets a full audience every day!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: On top of that, we're in the running to win the entire Show Contest!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And most importantly! We've made countless people smile each and every day up to this point!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is what we as Wonderlands×Showtime are truly capable of!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And out of all of that comes a single fact...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A fact...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! The fact is...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There are no limits to what we can accomplish!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, so this was what you were planning.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well, it's not any different from what he usually comes up with.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Listen, Emu...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I don't know what exactly is bothering you, but remember what we talked about the last time we were here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In order to make sure that you can make everyone smile, we want to do what we can to make you smile.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And it's not just me and you this time. You have Nene, Rui and Robo-Nene on your side.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So can you please tell us what took away that smile of yours?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And let's try to figure something out together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree with Tsukasa. You've given us so much already, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For a change, we should return the favor.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Please, Emu. Let us help you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Grandpa, what do I do...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I... I can't hold back my tears...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I promised not to cry anymore after we said goodbye to each other...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But they're saying that they want to help me smile...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You don't have to force yourself to smile!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everyone, thank you...
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And then that all happened...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A partnership to change the park's theme into one that revolves around these characters, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It has happened with other parks too, but to just scrap every ride or attraction that's gonna feel out of place...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And they're about to finalize their agreement. I didn't realize it was already this far along...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm sorry for not telling you all sooner...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I didn't want this to get in the way of trying to win the Show Contest...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I would've felt awful if it made everyone sad and... I couldn't bear doing that to you...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu, you dummy. You know that never would've happened...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Exactly!! It's going to take more than that to wipe the smile off my face!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How loud was that, Robo-Nene?
se_event_dream_2021_002

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: 95 dB. About the same as a dog barking...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Since when can you measure something like that?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyways, he feels the same way, so you don't have to worry about us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Honestly, we want to help you and would really rather have you just tell us.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Indeed. If it weren't for you, Emu, none of us would be here today.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let us return the favor in what way we can.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Precisely!! Now, let us begin planning how to overcome this issue!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... Partnering with another company...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Just what exactly can we do at this point? We could start a petition and collect signatures from people who really love PXL... Maybe?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But these aren't political entities we're dealing with here. They have no obligation to recognize any such protests.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This park may very well be struggling financially, but it would be all for naught if the park ended up folding by operating the way it has been...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So we need a way to make sure Phoenix Wonderland can stay afloat while maintaining its current image...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Unfortunately, the plan Emu's brothers have been working on is a good, practical solution.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Licensing fees aside, the name recognition of the characters alone would let them break even and help distinguish itself from other parks.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If we're to foil such a big plan, we'll need something to match it...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It just seems so hard...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No! There's nothing hard about this whatsoever!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Regardless of operations and visitor totals, everyone that comes here wants to smile!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which means there has to be a way for us to reach thousands of people all at once and make them smile!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. I know you're just running your mouth off, but I figured you'd say something like that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But as long as we're together...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It may not actually be that difficult.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. It may be a simple matter.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We just need to put on a show unlike any we've ever done.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Unlike any we've ever done...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. It's still in its infancy, but I believe it's a good plan.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You always speak in riddles at times like this...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All but it's all part of the act and attracting more visitors.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Fine, so be it. Whenever you get that look on your face, we end up putting on a good show so...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, have you finally learned to put some stock into my ideas?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Rui
rows.Line:
<Hah hah hah.>
<Heh heh heh.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Sigh*... They came up with another stupid plan. I'm sure of it...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But they do usually get things done when it matters.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Everyone's being so awesome...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I couldn't do or come up with anything on my own...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But it feels like we can do anything when we're all together.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What's up?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nothing... I just feel all warm and fuzzy inside!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Warm and fuzzy?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Before I talked to you, my heart felt like it was sinking so much, but now I feel all warm and fuzzy...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I can't really explain it but...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. I definitely understood that...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes. Really.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now! Let's all get up on the stage!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Why?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To get ourselves motivated!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're gonna need to move as a cohesive unit! We'll start by shouting our battle cry!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A battle cry?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So something along the lines of wonderhoy?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh! I wanna try!
Alright, I'll start...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? Emu, wait! The troupe leader should be...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: One, two...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everyone, wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Nene & Rui
rows.Line: <Wonderhoy!>

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: W-Wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why did you take the lead...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Who cares as long as it works in the end?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Right. And it does feel like it worked in some way.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What do you mean in some way?!
se_event_dream_2021_002

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: 102 dB. The sound of a train on an overpass.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Stop measuring me!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, good. It's working just fine.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, Rui. What's this plan of yours anyways?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, but it's far too soon to tell. It wouldn't be very interesting if I just told everyone now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I suppose a hint may be in order... How about Everything is a show?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll have to put everything we can into our next show, and I'll be counting on all of the help you can give me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. So our next show is going to be a spectacle like no other...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then let us get started on our preparations!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wonderlands×Showtime will unite as one to overcome this massive hurdle!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!!
